95727.overview:
The Berenstain Bears' A School Day is an Educational game, developed by Realtime Associates and published by Sega, which was released in 1995. Join in the excitement as the Berenstain Bears have a busy day at school. Children will learn the alphabet and create words by recognizing letters. Objects and animals will come to life as your children match and learn shapes and put them in their place. Using characters from the story and their own original art, your children will create and animate their own cartoons. Dot-to-dot games teach numbers and letters!

Identify objects and create the word!

Learn your ABC's and catch the letter!

Plant and water your garden with nimble fingers!

An easy video game develops dexterity!

Create and animate your own cartoon!

127648.overview: B-Robo Kabutack is an Educational game, developed and published by Bandai, which was released in 1997.

127669.overview: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S is an educational game, developed and published by Bandai, which was released in 1995. Based on the anime of the same name, this game requires the player to turns pages of the "cartridge" to access various mini-games. Those mini-games include changing the colors of objects, guessing correct number combinations, interacting at a tea party and decorating a cake. Afterwards the player will play a wheel of fortune-styled mini-game to combat the Death Busters, Nekonneru, Steering and Kaolinite, followed by final showdown between Nekonneru and Sailor Moon. The final mini-game allows the player to do dress-up with the sailor senshi.

127675.overview: B-Fighter Kabuto is an educational game, developed and published by Bandai, which was released in 1996.

127676.overview: Bioneun Nal is an Educational game, developed and published by Samsung, which was released in 1996.

127677.overview: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Sailor Stars: Tokimeki Party is an Educational game, developed and published by Bandai, which was released in 1996. Based on the Sailor Moon Sailor Stars anime series, this spin-off game features a selection of mini-games including memory match, a top-down shooter, musical chairs, a vertical shooter with balloons, a horizontal shooter against Sailor Iron Mouse, a platformer on clouds, a maze game, a catching game, an eating game and an object detecting game.

127678.overview: A Bug's Life is an educational game, based on the Pixar film on the same name. This game retells the story in the form of cut-scenes and mini-games, which take place in the ant colony or the bug circus. The player controls one of several bug characters to complete a task, mostly within a time limit. This game was developed and published by Sega, which was released in 1999 in South Korea and Japan.

127682.overview: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon SuperS is an Educational game, developed and published by Bandai, which was released in 1995. Based on the anime of the same name, this game requires the player to turns pages of the "cartridge" to access various mini-games. Those mini-games include questions with multiple choices, picking jewelry for the sailor senshi, playing dress-up with the girls and watching their transformation sequences. Eventually the player will play the Amazon Trio's mini-games such as Hawk's Eye's shell game, Tiger's Eye's ball game, and Fisheye's flying trapeze game. Lastly, the player is treated to a drawing program to freely draw a custom picture or color in an existing one.

147024.overview: Bakuryuu Sentai Abaranger immerses you in the world of brave Sentai warriors! In this gripping game, you'll fight alongside the brave Abarangers against terrible enemies. The action-packed levels require teamwork and strategic thinking as you battle evil. With impressive skills and exciting challenges, this adventure provides hours of fun. Join the Abaranger team and fight evil to save the world!
